scope: Semantic review of Phase 4 image privacy, admission, accounting, publication, release-audit, and public product documentation before refreshing the critical review fingerprint.
findings: Human inference is authenticated, entitlement-gated, quota-checked, reserved before dispatch, and private; no public human publishing pathway is documented or implemented in the reviewed surfaces.
Public discovery uses published Star Works and does not require image inference. The local UI now also exposes a signed-in private-creation entry point without changing the public primary navigation.
Allowance values and image weights remain explicitly UNAPPROVED; paid image checkout and dispatch remain fail-closed until approved values are supplied through the canonical typed configuration.

The Star publication migration uses persisted completed Star attempts and active/discoverable Star authority when preserving or publishing public Works. Runtime database certification remains blocked, so this is source review rather than deployed database proof.

The legacy /api/run image path converges on the metered private generation handler; ordinary unauthenticated requests are denied, an internal operational header alone is not a human identity, and the general queue endpoint rejects image work in both direct targets and nested pipeline steps before enqueue. Regression coverage passes.

Ambiguous upstream outcomes remain reserved; known pre-generation rejection and accepted terminal failure release only through idempotent lifecycle transitions. No automatic ambiguous retry or refund was added.

Source-bound product, API, billing, deployment, and operations guide bodies were reconciled to the current private-workspace/public-Star boundary; statements requiring hosted evidence remain explicitly unverified.
Append-only incident evidence and the ten overdue actions were reviewed separately; actions remain open, with follow-up observations assigned rather than closed by this local review.

verification.docs_impact: inspected; generated indexes and private incident records are expected unmapped outputs
verification.runtime_postgres: blocked: Docker daemon unavailable; no database behavior is claimed as runtime verified
verification.hosted_privacy_inventory: blocked: no production bucket, CDN, route, environment, or Supabase target was selected or queried
verification.allowance_approval: unapproved business input; no values fabricated

limitations: No production or hosted resource was queried or mutated.
Local tests and source review cannot certify deployed storage privacy, historical public object URLs, hosted database grants/RLS, or production routing.
Broader registered knowledge-domain attestations remain separate and were not refreshed by this critical-source review.
